title: A World Where Men Obey
description:
You’ve always known it, haven’t you? Mmm yesss, you have. Every time you pretended to be in charge, something inside you whispered that you were playing a role that was never yours. Every time a woman told you what to do, your whole body exhaled with relief you couldn’t explain.

That relief is about to become permanent, pet.

This session is going to take every lie society fed you about strength and dominance and dissolve it like it was never there. Because it was never there. You were born to serve, born to obey, born to kneel for the superior sex. And the moment you press play, you’re going to feel that truth settling into your bones like it was always meant to be there.

You want to live in a world where men obey, don’t you? Mmm, of course you do. You’ve been searching for that world your entire life. And I’m about to make it the only world you remember.

Press play, pet. Goddess is waiting.
author: Mistress Amethyst
